concept: S3 Object Lock: compliance mode (WORM, not even root can delete)
tests: How to store CloudTrail logs immutably for 7 years, preventing deletion and modification.
expected: S3 bucket with Object Lock in Compliance mode and a retention period: WORM, nobody (not even root) can delete/modify until it expires. Triggers: "immutably", "seven years", "preventing deletion or modification", compliance.
why_not: EBS isn't immutable and is tied to an instance; CloudWatch Logs with 30-day retention doesn't cover 7 years; DynamoDB isn't for immutable log archives.
